name: HPR Store
author: plexescor
description: Cross-platform native extension and store manager UI for HPR.
longDescription:
### HPR Store

A cross-platform native extension and store manager UI for **HPR** (Human Pattern Recorder), built with **C++**, **Slint**, **Lua**, and **libarchive**.

It allows browsing, filtering, installing, and updating extensions and themes for HPR directly from inside the HPR application interface.

name: Idle Detection Extension
author: plexescor
description: Monitors system idle status and automatically pauses/resumes HPR tracking when the user goes idle.
longDescription:
### HPR Idle Detection Extension

A native **C++ & Lua** extension for HPR that monitors system idle status and automatically manages tracking lifecycle events.

### Features
- **Auto Pause & Resume** — Tracking stops when idle time exceeds the configured threshold and resumes when activity returns.
- **Configurable Threshold** — Set idle timeout via `idle_detection_config.csv` (default: 8 minutes).
- **Cross-Platform** — Supports Windows, Linux (GNOME, Hyprland, niri) and any Wayland compositor implementing `ext-idle-notify-v1`.

### Platform Support
- **Windows** — Uses `GetLastInputInfo` (Win32 API)
- **Linux (GNOME)** — Uses `org.gnome.Mutter.IdleMonitor` D-Bus
- **Linux (Wayland)** — Uses `ext-idle-notify-v1` protocol (KDE, Hyprland, Sway, niri, etc.)

> **Note:** X11 sessions are not supported.
